title: Document __hitIndex
body:
when using the `item` template, we add a special property to each hit `__hitIndex` ([code](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/5cd002b0c2442cc952d59cecab335a55e61cbd35/src/components/Hits.js#L13)). This property makes it easy to number the items in a hits widget.

But this property is not documented, I didn't know about it before a [user found it again](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/2347). We should document it!

comments.body: shouldn't we call it `index` or something if we're going to document it?

I don't think `index` is an option. Also it's already the second iteration on this parameter name, and imho there is no good solution. Even `__index` does not seem overly better and `__hitIndex` gives some context. What cons do you see with `__hitIndex` @Haroenv ?
good enough I guess, `index` or `key`, without `__` would work best for me though ¯\\\_(ツ)_/¯
Oh ok I get your point. It would be nicer but we are injecting that in the hits and the `__` limits the risk of collision with already existing attributes.
Great point, the `__` prefix is according to spec then, I forgot about that
